text:
Maya (marketing): Heads-up — want to iterate the battlecard for cloud/LLM API comparisons before the webinar. Quick sync? Key asks: routing claim tightening, benchmark narrative, and a new inbound routing play.
Jorge (field): I'm +1. We need clearer econ bullets: 'predictable throughput' and 'cost per rendered token' — not just 'low cost'. Also add a routing fallback example.
Nina (product): @Maya can you share the latest benchmark numbers? Last deck had 95ms p95 on hosted but that was with batching. Need both batched/unbatched numbers.
Sam (research): I can pull numbers. Quick note: our latency SLOs need to be contrasted with generic cloud endpoints that degrade under load. Suggest a small chart.
ops-bot: Note: Dedicated tier supports canary rollouts per model; recommended wording: 'pin model versions, safe rollouts, audit logs'.
Jorge (field): For inbound lead routing, propose 3 buckets: Demo-ready (>=50k tokens monthly), Enterprise (security/SLA), Explore (trial). Map to SDR -> AE -> Solutions.
Maya (marketing): Love it. For the webinar hook, lean into a "serving-first" demo: live routing failover + cost dashboard. Quick ask: who's owning slides?
Nina (product): I can own slides with Sam's charts. @Jorge can you draft the routing play snippet? 1-2 slides.
Jorge (field): On it. Draft snippet below:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - priority: region
  - fallback: cost_tier
  - model_variants: [fp16, int8]
```
Will refine with a short anecdote about a failover.
Sam (research): :thumbsup: I'll export p50/p95 CSVs by EOD. Need to know whether to include quantized numbers.
Maya (marketing): Include quantized + unquantized. Also add a 1-liner competitor contrast: 'Cloud endpoints are general-purpose; Redwood offers serving ops and cost controls.' Keep it factual and provable.
Jorge (field): Agree. Keep claims provable. Recommend saving the 'fallback' example as a short customer anecdote (non-confidential).
Nina (product): Timeline check — slides by Wed, playbook update Thurs, battlecard final Fri. Sound right?
Maya (marketing): Yes. I'll set a kickoff 10am Wed and add an agenda: benchmark slides, routing play, 1-liner takedowns. Thanks all. :rocket:
